# Debug: Check what the element looks like during toc run
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ["python", "-c", """
import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import TocTreeprocessor, render_inner_html

# Patch to debug
original_run = TocTreeprocessor.run

def debug_run(self, doc):
    for el in doc.iter():
        if isinstance(el.tag, str) and self.header_rgx.match(el.tag):
            inner = render_inner_html(el)
            print(f"Element {el.tag}:")
            print(f"  text: {repr(el.text)}")
            print(f"  children: {[(c.tag, c.attrib, c.text, c.tail) for c in el]}")
            print(f"  inner_html: {repr(inner)}")
    return original_run(self, doc)

TocTreeprocessor.run = debug_run

md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'footnotes'])
text = '''# Header[^1]

Some text.

[^1]: Footnote text
'''
html = md.convert(text)
print("---")
print("Final HTML:")
print(html)
"""],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
print(result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-2000:])
